note: DRAFT. Active scope: probe + Tier A (n=3, M=1, mcz oracle, uniform start, matched diffusion, r=0..4, echo and readout controls). Tiers B and C are locked. Predictions are FakeMarrakesh (opt level 3) values from analysis/ladder_predictions.py.

preregistration.backend: ibm_marrakesh (availability and remaining plan seconds re-checked at adoption)
preregistration.layout: chosen by the transpiler on each day from that day's calibration; physical qubits, calibration timestamp and transpiled depth/2Q counts recorded for every job
preregistration.tolerance_rule: band half-width = 5*sqrt(p(1-p)/8192) + 0.05 (values in review/preregistration/ladder_predictions.json). Tolerance misses are reported.

probe.purpose: measure billed seconds for one tiny job before anything else
probe.stop_rule: if the probe bills more than 10 s, stop and re-plan

budget.unlock: separate written approval after Tier A analysis; new manifest, new hash, new tag
budget.reserve_rule: adopt only if remaining plan seconds >= 360; at least 200 s must remain unspent after this manifest
budget.enforcement: usage_budget_seconds (cumulative billed seconds) and max_job_seconds (per-job runtime limit) in this manifest, enforced by HardwareBackend.run_batch

preregistration.tier_stop_rule: If, over the 5 days, no Tier A ladder cell reaches 3x its r=0 value at r_opt, stop and report where amplification disappears.

analysis.primary_uncertainty: t-interval (95%, 4 d.f., t=2.776) across the 5 daily values of each quantity; shot-noise Wilson intervals reported alongside, not instead
analysis.primary: marked-state probability per cell vs prediction band; TVD to prediction with null floor and p-value; offset from M/N in standard errors
analysis.secondary: fit hardware fidelity per two-qubit gate (qfim_bench.fit) and compare with the simulator's 0.9967; echo and readout controls reported alongside
analysis.reporting: tolerance misses, null and negative results are reported

preregistration.estimate_caveat: execution time only; billed time includes per-job overhead and is measured by the probe
